introEn: Italian spelling is regular: learn the few letter groups whose sound changes.
introAr: الكتابة الإيطالية منتظمة؛ احفظ مجموعات الحروف القليلة التي يتغيّر نطقها.
tipEn: Look at the vowel after c or g: e/i make it soft, a/o/u keep it hard.
tipAr: انظر إلى حرف العلة بعد c أو g: مع e وi يلين الصوت، ومع a وo وu يبقى قويًا.

patterns.label: C / G dolce
patterns.formula: ce, ci · ge, gi
patterns.en: Before e or i: c sounds like “ch” in church, g like “j” in jam.
patterns.ar: قبل e أو i: c تُنطق تش وg تُنطق ج.

patterns.label: C / G dura
patterns.formula: ca, co, cu, che, chi · ga, go, gu, ghe, ghi
patterns.en: Hard “k” and “g”; add h before e/i to keep them hard.
patterns.ar: صوت ك وg القوي؛ نضيف h قبل e أو i للحفاظ عليه.

patterns.label: GN / GLI
patterns.formula: gnocchi · figlio
patterns.en: gn sounds like “ny”; gli like “lli” in million.
patterns.ar: gn تُنطق ني، وgli تُنطق لي ممدودة.

patterns.label: SC
patterns.formula: sci, sce · sca, sco, scu
patterns.ar: sci وsce تُنطقان ش، وsca وsco وscu تُنطق سك.

patterns.label: H
patterns.formula: ho · hai · ha · chi

patterns.label: Doppie
patterns.formula: pala / palla · caro / carro
patterns.en: Double consonants are held longer and can change the meaning.
patterns.ar: الحروف المضاعفة تُمدّ في النطق وقد تغيّر المعنى.

examples.en: I am hungry: ho (I have) is written with a silent h.
examples.ar: أنا جائعة: ho تُكتب بحرف h صامت.

examples.en: House / box, till: one s or two changes the word.
examples.ar: بيت / صندوق: حرف s واحد أو اثنان يغيّر الكلمة.

examples.en: Dinner (soft c) / church (hard c with h).
examples.ar: عشاء (c لينة) / كنيسة (c قوية مع h).

questions.q: Nella parola “ho”, la lettera ___ non si pronuncia.
questions.en: In the word “ho”, the letter h is silent.
questions.ar: في كلمة ho لا يُنطق حرف h.
questions.whyEn: H is always silent in Italian.
questions.whyAr: حرف h صامت دائمًا في الإيطالية.

questions.en: I eat a plate of gnocchi.
questions.whyEn: The “ny” sound is written gn, and the hard k before i is chi.
questions.whyAr: صوت ني يُكتب gn، وصوت ك القوي قبل i يُكتب chi.

questions.en: I go to church on Sundays.
questions.whyEn: To keep the hard k sound before e, write ch.
questions.whyAr: للحفاظ على صوت ك قبل e نكتب ch.

questions.q: Il ___ di mio padre è Marco. (son)
questions.en: My father's son is Marco.
In winter we go skiing.
questions.whyEn: The “sh” sound before i is written sci.
questions.whyAr: صوت ش قبل i يُكتب sci.

questions.en: A cup of coffee, please.
questions.whyEn: Tazza has a double z; tassa means tax.
questions.whyAr: tazza بحرفي z؛ أما tassa فتعني ضريبة.

questions.en: The child plays with the ball.
questions.whyEn: Palla (ball) has a double l; pala means shovel.
questions.whyAr: palla بحرفي l؛ أما pala فتعني مجرفة.

introEn: Use ciao with friends and buongiorno / buonasera with people you address as Lei.
introAr: استخدم ciao مع الأصدقاء، وbuongiorno أو buonasera مع من تخاطبهم بصيغة Lei.
tipEn: Tu for friends and family; Lei (with a 3rd-person verb) for polite address.
tipAr: tu للأصدقاء والعائلة، وLei مع فعل الغائب للمخاطبة المهذبة.

patterns.label: Informale
patterns.formula: Ciao! Come stai? · Mi chiamo…

patterns.label: Formale
patterns.formula: Buongiorno. Come sta? · Piacere.

patterns.label: Congedi
patterns.formula: Ciao · Arrivederci · A presto · Buonanotte
patterns.en: Ciao works for hello and goodbye; buonanotte only before bed.
patterns.ar: ciao للتحية والوداع؛ buonanotte قبل النوم فقط.

examples.en: Nice to meet you, I'm Haya.

questions.en: To the teacher I say: “Good morning, how are you?”
questions.ar: أقول للأستاذ: صباح الخير، كيف حالك؟
questions.whyEn: With Lei the verb is 3rd person singular: sta.
questions.whyAr: مع Lei يكون الفعل بصيغة الغائب المفرد: sta.

questions.en: “Hi, I'm Luca.” “Nice to meet you, Haya.”
It's 11 p.m., I'm going to bed: “Good night!”
questions.ar: الساعة 11 ليلًا، سأنام: تصبح على خير!
questions.whyEn: Buonanotte is said when going to bed.
questions.whyAr: نقول buonanotte عند الذهاب إلى النوم.

questions.en: My name is Haya.
questions.whyEn: Mi chiamo: reflexive chiamarsi with io.
questions.whyAr: mi chiamo: الفعل chiamarsi مع io.

questions.en: Where are you from? (formal)
I go into a shop at 6 p.m.: “Good evening!”
questions.ar: أدخل متجرًا في السادسة مساءً: مساء الخير!
questions.whyEn: From late afternoon Italians say buonasera.
questions.whyAr: من آخر بعد الظهر يقول الإيطاليون buonasera.

questions.en: Bye, see you soon!
questions.whyEn: The fixed phrase is a presto.

introEn: Every noun is masculine or feminine. The article changes with gender, number and the first letter of the word.
introAr: كل اسم مذكر أو مؤنث، وتتغيّر أداة التعريف حسب الجنس والعدد والحرف الأول من الكلمة.
tipEn: Masculine: il, but lo before s+consonant, z, gn, ps, y; l' before a vowel.
tipAr: للمذكر il، لكن lo قبل s مع حرف ساكن وz وgn وps وy، وl' قبل حرف العلة.

patterns.label: Maschile
patterns.formula: il libro → i libri · lo zaino → gli zaini · l'amico → gli amici
patterns.ar: -o تصبح -i؛ il تصبح i، وlo وl' تصبحان gli.

patterns.label: Femminile
patterns.formula: la casa → le case · l'amica → le amiche

patterns.label: -e
patterns.formula: il fiore → i fiori · la chiave → le chiavi

patterns.label: Indeterminativo
patterns.formula: un libro · uno zaino · una casa · un'amica

questions.en: The backpack is heavy.
questions.whyEn: Zaino starts with z, so the article is lo.
questions.whyAr: zaino تبدأ بـ z لذلك الأداة lo.

questions.en: The friends arrive at eight.
questions.whyEn: Masculine plural before a vowel: gli.
questions.whyAr: الجمع المذكر قبل حرف علة: gli.

questions.en: I bought two houses.
Will you give me the key?
It's a fantastic idea!
questions.whyEn: Feminine before a vowel: un' with an apostrophe.
questions.whyAr: المؤنث قبل حرف علة: un' مع الفاصلة العليا.

questions.en: I buy the flowers for Mum.
questions.whyEn: Fiore is masculine: il fiore → i fiori.
questions.whyAr: fiore مذكر: il fiore ← i fiori.

questions.en: There's a new student.
questions.whyAr: قبل s مع حرف ساكن: uno.

titleEn: Essere and Avere (to be / to have)
introEn: Essere identifies and describes; avere expresses possession, age and many feelings (fame, sete, paura).
introAr: essere للتعريف والوصف، وavere للملكية والعمر وكثير من الأحاسيس (fame وsete وpaura).
tipEn: Age uses avere: ho vent'anni (not sono vent'anni).
tipAr: العمر مع avere: ho vent'anni وليس sono vent'anni.

patterns.label: Essere
patterns.formula: sono, sei, è, siamo, siete, sono

patterns.label: Avere
patterns.formula: ho, hai, ha, abbiamo, avete, hanno
patterns.ar: الملكية والعمر والجوع والعطش والنعاس والخوف والبرد.

examples.en: Are you hungry? — No, I'm thirsty.
examples.ar: هل أنت جائع؟ — لا، أنا عطشان.

examples.en: The museum is in the centre.

questions.en: My sister is fifteen.
We are from Amman.
Close the window, I'm cold!
questions.whyEn: Being cold (a feeling) is avere freddo.

questions.en: They have two children.
You are very kind.
The book is on the table.
questions.whyEn: Location of a known thing: è.

questions.en: Are you afraid of the dark?

introEn: Remove -are, -ere or -ire and add the endings. Many -ire verbs add -isc- (capisco).
introAr: احذف -are أو -ere أو -ire وأضف النهايات. كثير من أفعال -ire تضيف -isc- مثل capisco.
tipEn: The noi form always ends in -iamo; the subject pronoun is usually left out.
tipAr: صيغة noi تنتهي دائمًا بـ -iamo، وغالبًا نحذف ضمير الفاعل.

patterns.label: -are
patterns.formula: parlo, parli, parla, parliamo, parlate, parlano

patterns.label: -ere
patterns.formula: leggo, leggi, legge, leggiamo, leggete, leggono

patterns.label: -ire
patterns.formula: dormo, dormi, dorme, dormiamo, dormite, dormono

patterns.label: -ire (-isc-)
patterns.formula: capisco, capisci, capisce, capiamo, capite, capiscono

examples.en: I speak Arabic and I study Italian.

questions.en: We're eating pizza tonight.
She is reading a book.
I don't understand the question.
Do you sleep late?
They work in a bank.

questions.q: Tu ___ il tè o il caffè? (preferire)
questions.en: Do you prefer tea or coffee?

questions.q: Mio padre ___ il giornale ogni mattina. (comprare)
questions.en: My father buys the paper every morning.

introEn: The most frequent verbs are irregular: andare, fare, venire, uscire, dire, dare, stare, bere.
introAr: أكثر الأفعال شيوعًا شاذة: andare وfare وvenire وuscire وdire وdare وstare وbere.
tipEn: Learn them as a set; noi and voi are often regular.
tipAr: احفظها كمجموعة؛ صيغتا noi وvoi غالبًا منتظمتان.

patterns.label: Andare
patterns.formula: vado, vai, va, andiamo, andate, vanno

patterns.label: Fare
patterns.formula: faccio, fai, fa, facciamo, fate, fanno

patterns.label: Venire
patterns.formula: vengo, vieni, viene, veniamo, venite, vengono

patterns.label: Uscire
patterns.formula: esco, esci, esce, usciamo, uscite, escono

patterns.label: Dire / bere
patterns.formula: dico, dici, dice… · bevo, bevi, beve…

examples.es: Vado al mare con gli amici.
examples.en: I'm going to the seaside with friends.

questions.en: Tomorrow I'm going to Rome.
What's the weather like today?
Are you coming to the party too?
The boys are going out tonight.
I always tell the truth.
We do our homework together.
He drinks a lot of water.

introEn: In Italian the thing you like is the subject: mi piace il gelato (ice cream pleases me).
introAr: في الإيطالية الشيء المحبوب هو الفاعل: mi piace il gelato أي يعجبني الآيس كريم.
tipEn: Singular thing or a verb → piace; plural things → piacciono.
tipAr: شيء مفرد أو فعل ← piace، وأشياء جمع ← piacciono.

patterns.label: Pronomi
patterns.formula: mi, ti, gli, le, ci, vi, gli

patterns.label: Piace
patterns.formula: Mi piace la musica · Mi piace ballare

patterns.label: Piacciono
patterns.formula: Ti piacciono i cani?

patterns.label: A + nome
patterns.formula: A Marco piace il calcio.

examples.es: Non mi piacciono i film dell'orrore.

questions.en: I like cats.
Do you like cooking?
Luca likes football.
Does she like pizza?
We like trips.
questions.whyEn: Plural thing with noi: ci piacciono.
questions.whyAr: شيء جمع مع noi: ci piacciono.

questions.en: Children like sweets.
I don't like this colour.

introEn: Chi (who), che cosa (what), dove (where), quando (when), come (how), perché (why), quanto (how much).
introAr: chi مَن، che cosa ماذا، dove أين، quando متى، come كيف، perché لماذا، quanto كم.
tipEn: Dove + è contracts to dov'è; quanto agrees with the noun: quanti anni, quante persone.
tipAr: dove مع è تصبح dov'è؛ وquanto تتوافق مع الاسم: quanti anni وquante persone.

patterns.label: Persone / cose
patterns.formula: Chi è? · Che cosa fai?

patterns.label: Luogo / tempo
patterns.formula: Dove abiti? · Quando parti?

patterns.label: Modo / causa
patterns.formula: Come stai? · Perché ridi?

patterns.label: Quantità
patterns.formula: Quanto costa? · Quanti anni hai?

examples.en: How many sisters do you have?

questions.en: Where do you live? — In Milan.
How old are you?
Who is that girl?
When does the train leave? — At nine.
What's your name?
questions.whyEn: Italian asks “how are you called?”: come.
questions.whyAr: الإيطالية تقول حرفيًا كيف تُدعى: come.

questions.en: How much is this bag?
Why aren't you coming? — Because I'm tired.
questions.whyEn: Perché asks why and also means because.
questions.whyAr: perché للسؤال لماذا وتعني أيضًا لأنّ.

introEn: From 20 on, numbers are joined in one word; tre at the end takes an accent (ventitré).
introAr: من العشرين فما فوق تُكتب الأعداد كلمة واحدة، وtre في النهاية تأخذ نبرة: ventitré.
tipEn: Venti + uno = ventuno (drop the vowel before uno and otto).
tipAr: venti مع uno تصبح ventuno (نحذف حرف العلة قبل uno وotto).

patterns.formula: uno, due, tre, quattro, cinque, sei, sette, otto, nove, dieci
undici, dodici, tredici, quattordici, quindici, sedici, diciassette, diciotto, diciannove

patterns.label: Decine
patterns.formula: venti, trenta, quaranta, cinquanta, sessanta, settanta, ottanta, novanta

patterns.label: Grandi
patterns.formula: cento, duecento, mille, duemila, un milione

questions.en: twenty-one
questions.whyEn: Drop the i before uno: ventuno.

questions.en: thirty-three
two thousand
eighteen
forty-eight
a hundred
fifteen

introEn: Possessives usually take the article: la mia casa. With a single family member, drop it: mia madre.
introAr: تأتي صفة الملكية عادةً مع أداة التعريف: la mia casa، لكن مع فرد واحد من العائلة تُحذف: mia madre.
tipEn: Keep the article with loro and with plural or modified family words: i miei fratelli, la mia sorellina.
tipAr: نُبقي الأداة مع loro ومع الجمع أو المصغّر: i miei fratelli وla mia sorellina.

patterns.label: Forme
patterns.formula: mio/mia/miei/mie · tuo… · suo… · nostro… · vostro… · loro
patterns.en: They agree with the thing owned.

patterns.label: Senza articolo
patterns.formula: mio padre · tua sorella · suo zio
patterns.ar: فرد واحد من العائلة دون وصف.

patterns.label: Con articolo
patterns.formula: i miei genitori · la loro madre · la mia mamma
patterns.ar: الجمع أو loro أو صيغ التدليل.

questions.en: My father is a doctor.
questions.whyAr: فرد واحد من العائلة: بلا أداة.

questions.en: My brothers study.
questions.whyEn: Plural family members keep the article.

questions.en: This is my car.
questions.whyAr: اسم ليس من العائلة: أداة مع mia.

questions.en: Marco loves his wife.
questions.whyEn: Moglie is feminine and a family member: sua.

questions.en: Their mother is young.
Where are your keys?
questions.whyEn: Chiavi is feminine plural: le tue.

questions.en: He's our friend Luca.
questions.whyAr: amico ليس من العائلة: il nostro.

titleEs: C'è / ci sono ed è / sono
titleEn: C'è / ci sono vs. è / sono
titleAr: c'è وci sono مقابل è وsono
introEn: C'è / ci sono say that something exists; è / sono locate or describe something already known.
introAr: c'è وci sono للتعبير عن وجود شيء، وè وsono لتحديد مكان شيء معروف أو وصفه.
tipEn: Use c'è with un/una/numbers; use è with il/la and names.
tipAr: استخدم c'è مع un وuna والأعداد، وè مع il وla والأسماء.

patterns.label: Esistenza
patterns.formula: C'è una farmacia? · Ci sono due bar.

patterns.label: Posizione
patterns.formula: La farmacia è a destra.

examples.en: The museum is in the square.

questions.en: There's a park near here.
There are three eggs in the fridge.
The station is in the centre.
Is there a problem?
The keys are on the table.
There are many people in the square.
Excuse me, where is the bathroom?
questions.whyAr: dove مع شيء معروف: è أي dov'è.

introEn: Before an adjective or after a verb, molto never changes; before a noun it agrees like an adjective.
introAr: قبل الصفة أو بعد الفعل لا تتغير molto، أما قبل الاسم فتتوافق معه كالصفة.
tipEn: Ask: is the next word a noun? Then molto / molta / molti / molte.
tipAr: اسأل: هل الكلمة التالية اسم؟ إذن molto أو molta أو molti أو molte.

patterns.label: Avverbio
patterns.formula: molto bello · lavoro molto

patterns.label: Aggettivo
patterns.formula: molto tempo · molta gente · molti amici · molte cose

questions.en: The pizza is very good.
There are many people.
I like reading a lot.
I don't have much time.
You have a lot of books!
We are very happy.
There's a lot of water in the glass.

introEn: Adjectives agree in gender and number; most follow the noun.
introAr: تتوافق الصفة في الجنس والعدد، ومعظم الصفات تأتي بعد الاسم.
tipEn: -o adjectives: -o/-a/-i/-e; -e adjectives: -e/-i.
tipAr: الصفات المنتهية بـ -o: -o و-a و-i و-e؛ والمنتهية بـ -e: -e و-i.

patterns.label: -o
patterns.formula: un ragazzo alto · una ragazza alta · ragazzi alti · ragazze alte

patterns.label: -e
patterns.formula: un libro interessante · libri interessanti

patterns.label: Prima del nome
patterns.formula: un bel giorno · una brava insegnante
patterns.en: Some common adjectives can go first.
patterns.ar: بعض الصفات الشائعة تأتي قبل الاسم.

questions.en: A small house.
Two interesting books.
The girls are tall.
My brother is nice.
I have green eyes.
An easy lesson.
The children are tired.
questions.whyEn: Masculine plural of stanco: stanchi (with h).
questions.whyAr: جمع stanco المذكر: stanchi مع h.

introEn: Put non right before the verb (and before object pronouns). Italian uses double negatives.
introAr: ضع non مباشرة قبل الفعل وقبل ضمائر المفعول. تستخدم الإيطالية النفي المزدوج.
tipEn: Non … niente / mai / nessuno / più: both words are needed.
tipAr: non … niente أو mai أو nessuno أو più: نحتاج الكلمتين معًا.

patterns.label: Base
patterns.formula: Non lavoro oggi.

patterns.label: Con pronome
patterns.formula: Non lo so.

patterns.label: Doppia negazione
patterns.formula: Non vedo niente · Non vado mai · Non c'è nessuno

questions.en: I don't understand.
questions.whyEn: The negative before a verb is non.

questions.en: I'm not hungry at all.
questions.whyEn: Non … per niente = not at all.
questions.whyAr: non … per niente أي لا على الإطلاق.

questions.en: There's nobody at home.
I don't know.
questions.whyEn: Non goes before the pronoun lo.

questions.en: I never drink coffee in the evening.
questions.ar: لا أشرب القهوة أبدًا في المساء.

questions.en: I don't want anything.
I don't live in Rome any more.

introEn: A, da, di, in and su join the definite article into one word.
introAr: تندمج a وda وdi وin وsu مع أداة التعريف في كلمة واحدة.
tipEn: Prepositions + il: al, dal, del, nel, sul.
tipAr: حروف الجر مع il: al وdal وdel وnel وsul.

patterns.label: + il / lo / l'
patterns.formula: al, allo, all' · del, dello, dell' · nel, nello, nell'

patterns.label: + la / i / gli / le
patterns.formula: alla, ai, agli, alle · sulla, sui, sugli, sulle

patterns.label: Con e per
patterns.formula: con il · per la
patterns.en: Con and per usually stay separate.

examples.en: The book is on the chair.

questions.en: The cat sleeps on the sofa.
I'm going to the seaside.
The keys are in the bag.
It's the students' book.
I come back from the office at six.
I speak to the friends.
The picture is on the wall.

titleEs: L'ora, i giorni e la data
introEn: Che ore sono? Sono le + number (but è l'una, è mezzogiorno). Days and months are lower-case.
introAr: كم الساعة؟ Sono le مع العدد (لكن è l'una وè mezzogiorno). الأيام والأشهر تُكتب بحروف صغيرة.
tipEn: Dates use the cardinal number: il 5 maggio, except il primo (1st).
tipAr: التاريخ بالعدد الأصلي: il 5 maggio، ما عدا il primo لليوم الأول.

patterns.label: Ora
patterns.formula: Sono le tre · È l'una · Sono le due e mezza
patterns.en: Plural sono le, except one o'clock.
patterns.ar: sono le للجمع ما عدا الواحدة.

patterns.label: A che ora?
patterns.formula: alle otto · all'una · a mezzogiorno

patterns.label: Data
patterns.formula: Oggi è il 12 marzo · il primo aprile

patterns.label: Giorni
patterns.formula: lunedì · il lunedì

examples.es: Che ore sono? — Sono le sette e un quarto.
examples.en: What time is it? — It's quarter past seven.

examples.es: Il mio compleanno è il 3 giugno.

questions.en: It's four o'clock.
questions.whyEn: For hours above one: sono le.

questions.en: It's ten past one.
questions.whyEn: One o'clock is singular: è l'una.

questions.en: The train leaves at six.
Today is the tenth of May.

questions.q: Il ___ aprile è il mio compleanno. (1st)
questions.en: The first of April is my birthday.
I go to the gym on Tuesdays.
questions.whyEn: Il + day = every week on that day.

questions.en: It's half past two.
questions.whyEn: Half past = e mezza (or e mezzo).

introEn: Reflexive verbs carry mi, ti, si, ci, vi, si before the conjugated verb. In the past they use essere.
introAr: الأفعال الانعكاسية تأخذ mi وti وsi وci وvi وsi قبل الفعل، وفي الماضي تأخذ essere.
tipEn: With an infinitive, the pronoun can attach: devo alzarmi / mi devo alzare.
tipAr: مع المصدر يمكن أن يتصل الضمير: devo alzarmi أو mi devo alzare.

patterns.label: Presente
patterns.formula: mi alzo, ti alzi, si alza, ci alziamo, vi alzate, si alzano

patterns.label: Passato
patterns.formula: mi sono alzata · ci siamo vestiti

patterns.label: Frequenza
patterns.formula: sempre · di solito · spesso · a volte · mai

questions.en: I get up early.
They get dressed quickly.
We have a lot of fun.
Yesterday Sara woke up late.
What's your name?
Tomorrow I have to get up early.
questions.whyEn: The pronoun attaches to the infinitive: alzarmi.

questions.en: Do you wash your hands?

introEn: Avere or essere + past participle. Movement, change and reflexive verbs take essere and agree with the subject.
introAr: avere أو essere مع اسم المفعول. أفعال الحركة والتغيّر والأفعال الانعكاسية تأخذ essere وتتطابق مع الفاعل.
tipEn: If the verb can take a direct object (mangiare qualcosa), it usually takes avere.
tipAr: إذا كان الفعل يأخذ مفعولًا مباشرًا (mangiare qualcosa) فغالبًا يأخذ avere.

patterns.label: Avere
patterns.formula: ho mangiato · hai visto · abbiamo fatto

patterns.label: Essere
patterns.formula: sono andata · è nato · siamo tornati

patterns.label: Participi irregolari
patterns.formula: fatto, detto, visto, preso, messo, letto, scritto, aperto, venuto, stato

questions.en: Yesterday I ate a pizza.
questions.whyEn: Mangiare takes avere; the participle doesn't change.
questions.whyAr: mangiare يأخذ avere واسم المفعول لا يتغير.

questions.en: The girls went to the cinema.
questions.whyEn: Andare takes essere; feminine plural: andate.
questions.whyAr: andare يأخذ essere؛ جمع مؤنث: andate.

questions.en: Who opened the door?
My grandfather was born in 1940.
What did you do last night?
We came home late.
Have you seen the film?
Lucia wrote a letter.

introEn: The imperfetto describes the background, habits and ongoing actions in the past.
introAr: يصف imperfetto الخلفية والعادات والأفعال المستمرة في الماضي.
tipEn: Endings are regular for almost all verbs: -avo, -evo, -ivo. Essere is ero, eri, era…
tipAr: النهايات منتظمة تقريبًا: -avo و-evo و-ivo. أما essere فتصبح ero وeri وera…

patterns.label: -are
patterns.formula: parlavo, parlavi, parlava, parlavamo, parlavate, parlavano

patterns.label: -ere / -ire
patterns.formula: leggevo · dormivo

patterns.label: Irregolari
patterns.formula: ero (essere) · facevo (fare) · dicevo (dire) · bevevo (bere)

examples.en: As a child I lived in Naples.
examples.ar: في طفولتي كنت أسكن في نابولي.

examples.en: Every summer we went to the seaside.
examples.ar: كل صيف كنا نذهب إلى البحر.

questions.en: As a child he played a lot.
When I was young, I lived in Milan.
questions.ar: عندما كنت شابة، كنت أعيش في ميلانو.

questions.en: The sky was grey.
What were you doing while I was calling you?
questions.ar: ماذا كنت تفعل بينما كنت أتصل بك؟

questions.q: Noi ___ sempre il treno delle otto. (prendere)
questions.en: We always took the eight o'clock train.
While I was sleeping, the phone rang.
My grandparents lived in the countryside.

introEn: Passato prossimo: a completed event. Imperfetto: the background, a description or a habit.
introAr: passato prossimo لحدث مكتمل، وimperfetto للخلفية أو الوصف أو العادة.
tipEn: Ieri, una volta, all'improvviso → usually passato prossimo; ogni giorno, mentre, di solito → imperfetto.
tipAr: ieri وuna volta وall'improvviso غالبًا مع passato prossimo؛ ogni giorno وmentre وdi solito مع imperfetto.

patterns.label: Evento
patterns.formula: Ieri ho visto Marco.

patterns.label: Sfondo
patterns.formula: Era tardi e faceva freddo.

patterns.label: Interruzione
patterns.formula: Mentre cucinavo, è arrivato Luca.

examples.en: When I arrived, it was raining.
As a child I read a lot.

examples.es: Ieri ho letto tutto il libro.
examples.en: Yesterday I read the whole book.

questions.en: Yesterday we went to the seaside.
questions.whyEn: A single completed event: passato prossimo.

questions.en: Every Sunday we had lunch at grandma's.
questions.ar: كل أحد كنا نتغدى عند الجدة.

questions.en: While I was reading, I heard a noise.
The house was big and bright.
Suddenly the power went out.
When I was little, I had a dog.
questions.ar: عندما كنت صغيرة كان لدي كلب.

questions.en: Last night I studied until midnight.
questions.ar: ليلة أمس درست حتى منتصف الليل.
questions.whyEn: A bounded completed action: passato prossimo.

titleEs: I pronomi diretti: lo, la, li, le
introEn: Lo, la, li, le replace a known direct object. They go before the conjugated verb.
introAr: تحل lo وla وli وle محل مفعول مباشر معروف، وتأتي قبل الفعل المصرف.
tipEn: In the passato prossimo, the participle agrees with lo/la/li/le: l'ho vista, li ho comprati.
tipAr: في passato prossimo يتطابق اسم المفعول مع الضمير: l'ho vista وli ho comprati.

patterns.label: Forme
patterns.formula: mi, ti, lo, la, ci, vi, li, le

patterns.label: Posizione
patterns.formula: Lo compro · Voglio comprarlo
patterns.en: Before the verb or attached to the infinitive.

patterns.label: Passato
patterns.formula: La pizza? L'ho mangiata.

examples.en: The book? I'll read it tonight.
Do you know Anna? Yes, I know her.

questions.en: Coffee? I take it without sugar.
The shoes? I'll buy them tomorrow.
The tickets? I already have them.
The cake? I made it.
questions.whyAr: اسم المفعول يتطابق مع la: fatta.

questions.q: Vuoi vedere il film? Sì, voglio ___ .
questions.en: Do you want to see the film? Yes, I want to see it.
questions.ar: هل تريد مشاهدة الفيلم؟ نعم أريد مشاهدته.

questions.en: Can you hear me? Yes, I can hear you well.
Marco and Luca? I don't know them.

titleEs: I pronomi indiretti: mi, ti, gli, le
introEn: Indirect pronouns answer “to whom?”: mi, ti, gli (to him / to them), le (to her), Le (to you, formal), ci, vi.
introAr: ضمائر المفعول غير المباشر تجيب عن لمن؟: mi وti وgli (له / لهم) وle (لها) وLe (لحضرتك) وci وvi.
tipEn: Telefonare, rispondere, scrivere, dare, dire take an indirect object: gli telefono.
tipAr: telefonare وrispondere وscrivere وdare وdire تأخذ مفعولًا غير مباشر: gli telefono.

patterns.label: Forme
patterns.formula: mi, ti, gli, le, Le, ci, vi, gli

patterns.label: Verbi tipici
patterns.formula: dare, dire, scrivere, telefonare, regalare, chiedere a

examples.en: Will you lend me the pen?

questions.en: I call Marco: I call him.
I write to my mother: I write to her.

questions.q: Che cosa ___ regali per Natale? (to me)
questions.en: What will you give me for Christmas?
I answer the customers: I answer them.
questions.whyEn: To them = gli (or loro after the verb).

questions.en: Madam, may I offer you a coffee?
questions.ar: سيدتي، هل يمكنني أن أقدم لك قهوة؟

questions.en: Will you tell us the truth?

questions.q: Il professore ___ spiega la regola. (to you all)
questions.en: The teacher explains the rule to you.

introEn: Ci replaces a place or a + something (ci vado = I go there). Ne replaces di + something or a quantity (ne voglio due).
introAr: ci تحل محل مكان أو a مع شيء (ci vado = أذهب إلى هناك)، وne تحل محل di مع شيء أو كمية (ne voglio due).
tipEn: Answer a quantity question with ne: Quanti caffè bevi? Ne bevo tre.
tipAr: أجب عن سؤال الكمية بـ ne: Quanti caffè bevi? Ne bevo tre.

patterns.label: Ci (luogo)
patterns.formula: Vai a Roma? Sì, ci vado domani.

patterns.label: Ci (a + cosa)
patterns.formula: Pensi al viaggio? Sì, ci penso.

patterns.label: Ne (quantità)
patterns.formula: Hai fratelli? Ne ho due.

patterns.label: Ne (di + cosa)
patterns.formula: Che ne pensi? · Ne parliamo dopo.

examples.es: Quante mele vuoi? Ne voglio tre.
examples.en: How many apples do you want? I want three.
I don't know anything about it.

questions.q: Vai spesso al cinema? Sì, ___ vado ogni sabato.
questions.en: Do you often go to the cinema? Yes, I go there every Saturday.
questions.ar: هل تذهب كثيرًا إلى السينما؟ نعم أذهب كل سبت.

questions.en: How many children do you have? I have two.
What do you think of this film?

questions.q: Pensi ancora a lei? Sì, ___ penso sempre.
questions.en: Do you still think about her? Yes, I always think about her.
questions.ar: هل ما زلت تفكر فيها؟ نعم أفكر فيها دائمًا.

questions.q: Vuoi del pane? Sì, ___ prendo un po'.
questions.en: Do you want some bread? Yes, I'll have a bit.
questions.ar: هل تريد خبزًا؟ نعم آخذ قليلًا منه.

questions.q: Sei mai stata in Sicilia? No, non ___ sono mai stata.
questions.en: Have you ever been to Sicily? No, I've never been there.
questions.ar: هل زرت صقلية؟ لا، لم أزرها قط.

questions.q: Parliamo del problema? Sì, ___ parliamo domani.
questions.en: Shall we talk about the problem? Yes, let's talk about it tomorrow.
questions.ar: هل نتحدث عن المشكلة؟ نعم نتحدث عنها غدًا.

introEn: Più / meno + adjective + di (before a noun or pronoun); così… come or tanto… quanto for equality.
introAr: più أو meno مع الصفة ثم di قبل الاسم أو الضمير؛ وcosì… come أو tanto… quanto للمساواة.
tipEn: Use che instead of di when comparing two adjectives, verbs or nouns of the same thing: più bello che utile.
tipAr: استخدم che بدل di عند مقارنة صفتين أو فعلين لشيء واحد: più bello che utile.

patterns.label: Superiorità
patterns.formula: Roma è più grande di Firenze.

patterns.label: Inferiorità
patterns.formula: Il treno è meno caro dell'aereo.

patterns.label: Uguaglianza
patterns.formula: Sono (così) alta come te.

patterns.label: Irregolari
patterns.formula: migliore (better) · peggiore (worse) · meglio / peggio (adverbs)

examples.es: Mia sorella è più alta di me.
examples.en: My sister is taller than me.

examples.es: È più facile parlare che scrivere.

questions.en: Milan is bigger than Bologna.
This book is better than that one.
Today I feel better.
questions.whyEn: With a verb, use the adverb meglio.

questions.en: It's more beautiful than useful.
Luca is as tall as his father.
The train is cheaper than the plane.

questions.q: Mi piace più leggere ___ guardare la TV.
questions.en: I like reading more than watching TV.
questions.ar: أحب القراءة أكثر من مشاهدة التلفاز.

introEn: The future expresses plans, predictions and guesses about the present (Sarà stanco = he's probably tired).
introAr: المستقبل للخطط والتوقعات والتخمين في الحاضر (sarà stanco = لعله متعب).
tipEn: -are verbs change a to e: parlerò. Many common verbs have short stems: andrò, avrò, sarò, farò, potrò, vorrò, verrò.
tipAr: في أفعال -are تتحول a إلى e: parlerò. وكثير من الأفعال لها جذور قصيرة: andrò وavrò وsarò وfarò وpotrò وvorrò وverrò.

patterns.label: Regolari
patterns.formula: parlerò, leggerò, dormirò

patterns.label: Irregolari
patterns.formula: sarò, avrò, andrò, farò, verrò, vorrò, potrò, dovrò, berrò

patterns.label: Probabilità
patterns.formula: Dov'è Anna? Sarà a casa.

examples.en: Tomorrow I'll go to the doctor.

examples.es: Che ore saranno? Saranno le dieci.
examples.en: What time might it be? It's probably ten.
examples.ar: كم الساعة يا ترى؟ لعلها العاشرة.

questions.en: Next year I'll go to Italy.
questions.whyEn: Andare has the short stem andr-.

questions.en: Tomorrow we'll call grandma.
Where's Luca? He's probably at the office.
questions.whyEn: Future for a guess about now.

questions.en: When I have time, I'll help you.
questions.whyEn: Italian uses the future after quando for future time.
questions.whyAr: الإيطالية تستخدم المستقبل بعد quando للزمن القادم.

questions.en: What will you do when you grow up?
Will they come to the party?
I'll never be able to forget you.

introEn: The conditional makes polite requests, gives advice and expresses wishes or hypothetical results.
introAr: يُستخدم condizionale للطلبات المهذبة والنصائح والرغبات والنتائج الافتراضية.
tipEn: Same stem as the future + -ei, -esti, -ebbe, -emmo, -este, -ebbero: vorrei, potrei, dovresti.
tipAr: الجذر نفسه للمستقبل مع -ei و-esti و-ebbe و-emmo و-este و-ebbero: vorrei وpotrei وdovresti.

patterns.label: Cortesia
patterns.formula: Vorrei un caffè · Potrebbe aiutarmi?

patterns.label: Consiglio
patterns.formula: Dovresti riposare.

patterns.label: Desiderio
patterns.formula: Mi piacerebbe viaggiare.

examples.en: I'd like to book a table.

examples.es: Al tuo posto, studierei di più.
examples.en: In your place, I'd study more.
I'd love to live by the sea.

questions.en: I'd like a cappuccino, please.
You're tired: you should sleep more.
questions.ar: أنت متعبة: يجب أن تنامي أكثر.

questions.en: Excuse me, could you help me?
I'd love to visit Japan.
We'd gladly come, but we can't.
questions.ar: كنا سنأتي بكل سرور لكننا لا نستطيع.

questions.en: In your place, I wouldn't do it.
They'd prefer a bit of silence.

introEn: Tu: -are → -a (parla), -ere/-ire → -i (leggi, senti). Negative tu: non + infinitive. Lei uses the subjunctive.
introAr: مع tu: أفعال -are تنتهي بـ -a، و-ere و-ire بـ -i. والنهي مع tu: non + المصدر. ومع Lei نستخدم congiuntivo.
tipEn: Pronouns attach to tu/noi/voi commands (fallo, dimmi) but go before Lei commands (lo faccia).
tipAr: الضمائر تتصل بأمر tu وnoi وvoi (fallo وdimmi) لكنها تأتي قبل أمر Lei (lo faccia).

patterns.label: Tu
patterns.formula: parla! · prendi! · senti!

patterns.label: Non + infinito
patterns.formula: non parlare! · non toccare!

patterns.label: Lei
patterns.formula: parli! · prenda! · senta!

patterns.label: Irregolari
patterns.formula: va' · fa' · da' · di' · sta' (dammi, fammi, dimmi)

questions.en: Close the door!
Don't talk so loudly!
Madam, do come in!
questions.whyEn: Lei command uses the subjunctive: entri.

questions.en: Tell me the truth!
Pay attention!
The book? Take it!
questions.whyEn: Pronoun attaches to the tu command.

questions.en: Wait a moment, please.

introEn: Use it after che with verbs of opinion, wish, doubt, emotion and necessity: penso che, voglio che, è importante che.
introAr: استخدمه بعد che مع أفعال الرأي والرغبة والشك والشعور والضرورة: penso che وvoglio che وè importante che.
tipEn: The three singular forms are identical, so add the subject if needed: che io / tu / lui vada.
tipAr: صيغ المفرد الثلاث متطابقة، فأضف الفاعل عند الحاجة: che io أو tu أو lui vada.

patterns.label: -are
patterns.formula: parli, parli, parli, parliamo, parliate, parlino

patterns.label: -ere / -ire
patterns.formula: legga… · dorma… · capisca…

patterns.label: Irregolari
patterns.formula: sia (essere) · abbia (avere) · vada · faccia · venga · possa · voglia

patterns.label: Stesso soggetto
patterns.formula: Penso di partire (not che io parta).

questions.en: I think Marco is right.

questions.q: Spero che il treno ___ in orario. (arrivare)
questions.en: I hope the train arrives on time.
questions.ar: آمل أن يصل القطار في موعده.

questions.q: È meglio che tu ___ a casa. (restare)
questions.en: It's better that you stay at home.
questions.ar: من الأفضل أن تبقى في البيت.

questions.en: I want you to know the truth.
I think it's late.
I think I'll leave tomorrow.
They need to come early.

introEn: Si + 3rd-person verb makes general statements (si mangia bene qui). With a plural noun the verb is plural.
introAr: si مع فعل الغائب للتعبير العام (si mangia bene qui)، ومع اسم جمع يكون الفعل جمعًا.
tipEn: With adjectives after si è, use the plural: si è contenti.
tipAr: مع الصفة بعد si è نستخدم الجمع: si è contenti.

patterns.label: Impersonale
patterns.formula: Qui si parla italiano.

patterns.label: Passivante
patterns.formula: Si vendono case · Si affitta camera

patterns.label: Riflessivo + si
patterns.formula: Ci si alza presto.

examples.en: In Italy people have dinner late.
How do you say it in Italian?

questions.en: English is spoken here.
Newspapers are sold in this shop.
How is this word written?
On holiday people get up late.
questions.whyAr: فعل انعكاسي غير شخصي: ci si.

questions.q: Quando si è stanchi, si ___ male.
questions.en: When you're tired, you work badly.
questions.ar: عندما يكون المرء متعبًا يعمل بشكل سيئ.

questions.en: You can see the mountains from here.
Flat for rent downtown.

titleEs: I pronomi relativi: che, cui, il quale
introEn: Che is the subject or direct object; cui follows a preposition; il cui expresses possession.
introAr: che فاعل أو مفعول مباشر، وcui بعد حرف الجر، وil cui للملكية.
tipEn: Never put che after a preposition: la persona con cui parlo.
tipAr: لا تضع che بعد حرف الجر أبدًا: la persona con cui parlo.

patterns.label: Che
patterns.formula: Il libro che leggo · la ragazza che parla

patterns.label: Preposizione + cui
patterns.formula: la città in cui vivo · l'amico a cui scrivo

patterns.label: Il cui
patterns.formula: lo scrittore il cui libro…
patterns.en: Whose; article agrees with the thing owned.
patterns.ar: الذي … له؛ الأداة تتطابق مع الشيء المملوك.

patterns.label: Ciò che / quello che
patterns.formula: Ciò che dici è vero.

examples.es: È la casa in cui sono nata.
examples.en: It's the house where I was born.

examples.es: Il ragazzo che hai visto è mio fratello.
examples.en: The boy you saw is my brother.
I don't understand what you're saying.

questions.q: Il film ___ abbiamo visto era bello.
questions.en: The film we saw was good.

questions.q: La ragione per ___ ti chiamo è semplice.
questions.en: The reason I'm calling you is simple.
questions.ar: السبب الذي أتصل بك من أجله بسيط.

questions.en: She's the friend I wrote to.

questions.q: La signora, ___ figlio è medico, abita qui.
questions.en: The lady, whose son is a doctor, lives here.
questions.ar: السيدة التي ابنها طبيب تسكن هنا.

questions.q: ___ mi piace di più è il mare.
questions.en: What I like most is the sea.

questions.q: Il paese da ___ vengo è piccolo.
questions.en: The village I come from is small.

questions.q: Ho incontrato una persona ___ conosce tuo padre.
questions.en: I met someone who knows your father.

introEn: Real: se + present, present/future. Possible: se + imperfect subjunctive, conditional. Impossible: se + pluperfect subjunctive, past conditional.
introAr: الواقعي: se مع المضارع ثم المضارع أو المستقبل. المحتمل: se مع congiuntivo imperfetto ثم الشرط. المستحيل: se مع congiuntivo trapassato ثم الشرط الماضي.
tipEn: Never use the conditional after se.
tipAr: لا نستخدم الشرط بعد se أبدًا.

patterns.label: Realtà
patterns.formula: Se piove, resto a casa.

patterns.label: Possibilità
patterns.formula: Se avessi tempo, verrei.

patterns.label: Irrealtà
patterns.formula: Se l'avessi saputo, sarei venuta.

examples.en: If you want, I'll come with you.
If I were rich, I'd always travel.

examples.es: Se fossimo partiti prima, non avremmo perso il treno.
examples.en: If we'd left earlier, we wouldn't have missed the train.
examples.ar: لو انطلقنا مبكرًا لما فاتنا القطار.

questions.en: If I had time, I'd come with you.
questions.ar: لو كان لدي وقت لأتيت معك.

questions.q: Se ___ bel tempo, andiamo al mare. (fare)
questions.en: If the weather is good, we'll go to the seaside.
questions.ar: إذا كان الطقس جميلًا نذهب إلى البحر.

questions.q: Se fossi in te, non lo ___ . (fare)
questions.en: If I were you, I wouldn't do it.
If I had known, I would have told you.
If we were rich, we'd buy a villa.
If I had studied, I would have passed the exam.
If you call me, I'll answer straight away.

introEn: Essere (or venire in simple tenses) + participle; the participle agrees; the agent follows da.
introAr: essere (أو venire في الأزمنة البسيطة) مع اسم المفعول المتطابق، والفاعل الحقيقي بعد da.
tipEn: Andare + participle expresses obligation: il modulo va compilato (must be filled in).
tipAr: andare مع اسم المفعول تعبّر عن الإلزام: il modulo va compilato أي يجب ملؤه.

patterns.label: Essere
patterns.formula: La lettera è stata scritta da Anna.

patterns.label: Venire
patterns.formula: Il museo viene chiuso alle sei.

patterns.label: Andare
patterns.formula: Questo va fatto subito.

examples.es: Il Colosseo è stato costruito dai Romani.
examples.en: The Colosseum was built by the Romans.

examples.es: Il libro viene letto in tutto il mondo.
examples.en: The book is read all over the world.
examples.ar: يُقرأ الكتاب في جميع أنحاء العالم.

questions.q: La Divina Commedia è stata scritta ___ Dante.
questions.en: The Divine Comedy was written by Dante.
The letters were sent yesterday.
The shop is closed on Mondays.
The homework must be done by tomorrow.

questions.q: Il ladro è stato ___ dalla polizia. (arrestare)
questions.en: The thief was arrested by the police.
The house was sold last year.
These data are checked every day.

introEn: After a past trigger, use the imperfect subjunctive (Volevo che venissi). For a completed action seen from the present, use the past subjunctive (Spero che sia arrivato).
introAr: بعد محفز في الماضي نستخدم congiuntivo imperfetto، ولحدث مكتمل من منظور الحاضر نستخدم congiuntivo passato.
tipEn: Imperfect subjunctive: -assi, -essi, -issi; essere → fossi, dare → dessi, stare → stessi.
tipAr: congiuntivo imperfetto: -assi و-essi و-issi؛ essere ← fossi وdare ← dessi وstare ← stessi.

patterns.label: Imperfetto
patterns.formula: parlassi, leggessi, dormissi · fossi, avessi, facessi

patterns.label: Passato
patterns.formula: abbia parlato · sia partito

patterns.label: Concordanza
patterns.formula: Penso che venga / Pensavo che venisse

examples.en: I wanted you to call me.
I think he has already eaten.

questions.en: I thought you were Italian.

questions.q: Mia madre voleva che io ___ medicina. (studiare)
questions.en: My mother wanted me to study medicine.

questions.q: Spero che Luca ___ il treno. (prendere, past)
questions.en: I hope Luca has caught the train.
questions.ar: آمل أن يكون لوكا قد استقل القطار.
questions.whyEn: Completed action from now: abbia preso.
questions.whyAr: حدث مكتمل من منظور الآن: abbia preso.

questions.en: I didn't know you were brothers.
questions.whyAr: محفز في الماضي مع voi: foste.

questions.en: It seems to me they've already left.
questions.whyAr: محفز حاضر مع حدث مكتمل: siano partiti.

questions.q: Era necessario che tutti ___ in orario. (arrivare)
questions.en: It was necessary for everyone to arrive on time.
questions.ar: كان من الضروري أن يصل الجميع في الموعد.

questions.q: Speravo che mi ___ un regalo. (fare, tu)
questions.en: I was hoping you'd give me a present.
questions.ar: كنت آمل أن تقدم لي هدية.

introEn: Anche se takes the indicative; benché, sebbene, nonostante (che) and malgrado take the subjunctive.
introAr: anche se تأخذ indicativo، أما benché وsebbene وnonostante وmalgrado فتأخذ congiuntivo.
tipEn: Qualunque, chiunque, dovunque also take the subjunctive.
tipAr: qualunque وchiunque وdovunque تأخذ congiuntivo أيضًا.

patterns.label: Indicativo
patterns.formula: Anche se piove, esco.

patterns.label: Congiuntivo
patterns.formula: Benché piova, esco.

patterns.label: Indefiniti
patterns.formula: Qualunque cosa succeda · chiunque venga

examples.es: Sebbene sia stanca, continuo a lavorare.
examples.en: Although I'm tired, I keep working.

examples.es: Anche se è tardi, ti chiamo.
examples.en: Even though it's late, I'll call you.
examples.ar: مع أن الوقت متأخر سأتصل بك.
أيًّا كان القادم فهو مرحب به.

questions.en: Although it's cold, we're going out.
Even if it's late, I'll wait for you.
questions.ar: حتى لو كان الوقت متأخرًا سأنتظرك.

questions.q: Sebbene ___ molto, non ha superato l'esame. (studiare)
questions.en: Although he studied a lot, he didn't pass.
questions.ar: مع أنه درس كثيرًا لم ينجح.

questions.en: Whatever happens, I'll help you.

questions.q: Nonostante ___ la verità, nessuno gli crede. (dire)
questions.en: Although he tells the truth, nobody believes him.
questions.ar: مع أنه يقول الحقيقة لا أحد يصدقه.

questions.q: Chiunque ___ , digli che non ci sono. (chiamare)
questions.en: Whoever calls, tell them I'm not here.
questions.ar: أيًّا كان المتصل قل له إنني لست هنا.

questions.q: Anche se non ___ voglia, devo andare. (avere)
questions.en: Even though I don't feel like it, I have to go.
questions.ar: مع أنني لا أرغب في ذلك يجب أن أذهب.

introEn: With a past reporting verb, tenses shift back: presente → imperfetto, passato prossimo → trapassato, futuro → condizionale passato.
introAr: مع فعل نقل في الماضي تتراجع الأزمنة: المضارع ← imperfetto، وpassato prossimo ← trapassato، والمستقبل ← الشرط الماضي.
tipEn: Time words change too: domani → il giorno dopo, ieri → il giorno prima, qui → lì.
tipAr: تتغير كلمات الزمن أيضًا: domani ← il giorno dopo، وieri ← il giorno prima، وqui ← lì.

patterns.label: Presente → imperfetto
patterns.formula: «Sono stanca» → Ha detto che era stanca.

patterns.label: Passato → trapassato
patterns.formula: «Ho finito» → Ha detto che aveva finito.

patterns.label: Futuro → condizionale passato
patterns.formula: «Verrò» → Ha detto che sarebbe venuto.

examples.es: Mi ha detto che sarebbe arrivato il giorno dopo.
examples.en: He told me he would arrive the next day.
examples.ar: قال لي إنه سيصل في اليوم التالي.

examples.en: She asked if I was hungry.

examples.es: Ha detto che l'aveva già visto.
examples.en: He said he had already seen it.

questions.en: “I'm hungry.” → She said she was hungry.

questions.q: «Partirò domani.» → Ha detto che ___ il giorno dopo.
questions.en: “I'll leave tomorrow.” → He said he would leave the next day.
questions.ar: قال إنه سيغادر في اليوم التالي.

questions.q: «Ho perso le chiavi.» → Ha detto che ___ le chiavi.
questions.en: “I've lost the keys.” → She said she had lost the keys.
“Are you coming?” → He asked me whether I was coming.

questions.q: «Ci vediamo domani.» → Ha detto che ci saremmo visti ___ .
questions.en: He said we'd see each other the next day.
questions.ar: قال إننا سنلتقي في اليوم التالي.

questions.q: «Chiudi la porta!» → Mi ha detto ___ chiudere la porta.
questions.en: He told me to close the door.
“I'm here.” → She said she was there.

introEn: Formal Italian turns verbs and adjectives into nouns: arrivare → l'arrivo, preciso → la precisione.
introAr: تحوّل الإيطالية الرسمية الأفعال والصفات إلى أسماء: arrivare ← l'arrivo، وpreciso ← la precisione.
tipEn: Common endings: -zione, -mento, -ità, -ezza, -anza/-enza.
tipAr: النهايات الشائعة: -zione و-mento و-ità و-ezza و-anza و-enza.

patterns.label: -zione
patterns.formula: organizzare → organizzazione

patterns.label: -mento
patterns.formula: cambiare → cambiamento

patterns.label: -ità / -ezza
patterns.formula: possibile → possibilità · bello → bellezza

patterns.label: -anza / -enza
patterns.formula: importante → importanza · presente → presenza

examples.es: La partenza è prevista alle otto.

questions.en: to change → the change
possible → the possibility
to organise → the organisation
kind → kindness
important → importance
to leave → departure
to improve → improvement
